settings: smoothing off, online offset batch (alpha 0.2, eta_b 0.05 per 2 s batch)

post_definition: forecast made at t >= switch_t (so the first post forecasts come due at switch_t + 2 s)
nominal_joint_coverage: a 5-95% interval on each of two axes covers ~0.9 x 0.9 = 81% jointly if calibrated and independent

window.note: forecasts made at t >= 5 s that came due by 20 s (what the GIF's last frame shows)
